Database Block Stream

gxStream sends DataReel database blocks between a client and a server over TLS.

Contents

Overview
Functions

Overview

Each message is a gxBlockHeader followed by block_length bytes; the header's status byte says what the block is (gxSendBlock, gxRequestBlock, gxAddRemoteBlock, gxAcknowledgeBlock, gxCloseConnection and so on). The format is the same as 6.x, but the connection is now a gxsTLSConnection. A client calls Connect(); a server accepts a client with gxsTLSServer::Accept(stream.Connection()). Block lengths read from the network are checked against SetMaxBlockSize() (64 MB by default) before memory is allocated. See examples/tls/stream_server.cpp and stream_client.cpp.
